result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks with decorative patterns and a marked crosswalk equipped with curb ramps and tactile paving. However, the crossing is uncontrolled and lacks high-visibility markings or signage, and sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles on the left side of the street.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street near the crosswalk may block the view of pedestrians for oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, upstream of the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks signals or signage to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians at this intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard transverse markings to continental or ladder style for better visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at the uncontrolled crossing.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of formal crossing infrastructure despite the presence of pedestrians and a large institutional building. While sidewalks are present, the absence of marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or traffic calming measures creates a high-exposure environment for those attempting to cross the two-way street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no designated or marked crosswalk at this intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected through vehicle travel lanes.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and parked vehicles on the right side of the street may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway and sidewalk corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and alert drivers to the crossing location.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Pedestrian Crossing' warning signs, potentially with solar-powered flashing beacons, to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The image depicts a commercial street corner with continuous sidewalks and a curb ramp, but lacks high-visibility crosswalk markings at the immediate intersection. The roadway shows signs of wear with cracked pavement, and there is a notable absence of traffic control devices or pedestrian-specific safety infrastructure like signals or refuge islands.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection Crossing
hazards.description: The immediate intersection lacks visible crosswalk markings, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area near the blue building corner

hazards.name: Degraded Roadway Surface
hazards.description: Cracked and patched pavement in the roadway and near the curb ramp creates trip hazards and uneven surfaces for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.description: Add lower-level lighting focused on the sidewalks and crossings to improve nighttime safety in this commercial area.
